scenario: LTHE.2.5.3 — `latest` pins the anchor to its most recent match BEFORE THE FOLLOWER. DoorOpen at ts 1, Motion at ts 2, DoorOpen at ts 3, all asserted before one pump. The ts-3 DoorOpen follows the Motion, so it cannot match it and must not exclude the ts-1 anchor: the rule fires once, logging `1`. Drives the NOT sub-node's placement and test (RLOW.5.6.5.2): a NOT placed straight after the anchor's alpha can only test `other.ts > anchor.ts`, blocks d1 on d2, and logs nothing. The log reads the anchor's `n`, which mirrors its `ts`, because `ts` is a `Time` ([LFAC.9.1]) and the vector should not depend on how a `Time` renders.
rules_ds:
schema DoorOpen scope ttl 1_h:
    loc: String
    n: Int
    ts: Time

schema Motion scope ttl 1_h:
    loc: String
    ts: Time

rule entry:
    latest DoorOpen d
    then Motion within 30_s
->
    log info "{d.n}"
